title: Hotel Booking (B2C) — Competitive Benchmark built from Mobbin
subtitle: Desk benchmark of real mobile booking flows captured on Mobbin, following the structure of the 'hotel-booking-competitor-benchmark' kit.

readme.heading: HOW THIS DIFFERS FROM THE ORIGINAL KIT
rows: The original kit asks you to run each booking yourself. This version is pre-filled from Mobbin screen recordings of each app's iOS booking flow. Every observation is traceable to a flow on the 'Evidence Index' tab.
Layout, information hierarchy, copy, price presentation, number of steps, CTA wording, policies shown, and payment options visible at the time of capture.

Speed, error handling, autocomplete quality, animation feel, guest-checkout availability when the capture was logged in, and payment methods for markets other than the one captured. These rows are marked 'Self-test' in the Evidence column.

Captures are from different markets and dates (Booking.com: US, 2026 dates; Agoda: Singapore, 2026; Trip.com: Vietnam/US$, 2025; Airbnb: US, 2025; Marriott: Japan/Singapore member, 2025; Hyatt: US, 2024). Apps may have changed since. Treat findings as a strong starting point, then validate the top items by hand.

readme.heading: PLATFORM SET
rows: Booking.com (global OTA) · Agoda (regional OTA, SEA-strong) · Trip.com (regional OTA, stand-in for a local Asian OTA) · Airbnb (alternative lodging) · Marriott Bonvoy (chain direct) · World of Hyatt (chain direct, booking steps only).

Traveloka and Tiket.com returned no results on Mobbin. Their columns are left in yellow for you to fill by self-testing. They matter most for Indonesian payment methods, so prioritise them for stage 6.

readme.heading: HOW TO USE
rows: Each cell describes what the app does for that criterion. 'Not captured' means the Mobbin flow did not include that moment, not that the app lacks it.
Green STAGE SCORE rows hold a 1–5 desk score per platform, judged from the screenshots. Edit any score you disagree with; the Scoring Summary tab updates automatically.
Yellow cells (Traveloka, Tiket.com, and 'Self-test' rows) need hands-on testing. Do it on mobile first, as the original kit advises.
The 'Patterns' tab lists what to copy and what to avoid, each with the Mobbin link to show stakeholders.

readme.heading: SCORING SCALE (same as original kit)
rows: Gets the job done; nothing memorable either way.
I would abandon here if this were a real booking.

readme.heading: WHY THESE CRITERIA
rows: Criteria lean toward the top documented causes of booking abandonment cited in the original kit (Baymard Institute): unexpected extra costs, forced account creation, long or complicated checkout, payment trust, and total cost not shown upfront. The 'Driver' column links each criterion to one of these.

readme.heading: LEGEND
rows: Blue band = funnel stage · Green row = stage score (editable) · Yellow = needs your input · Red cell = notable friction

criteria.criterion: Search is the primary home content
criteria.look_for: Is the search form the first thing on the stays home screen, above promos?

observations.Booking.com: Search card (destination, dates, guests) is the first block on the Stays tab.
observations.Agoda: 'All rooms' search panel at top with Overnight / Day Use tabs.
observations.Trip.com: Stays search card at top over a hero image.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Book tab; offer pages lead straight to a Search button.

criteria.implication: Put search above any promo on the home screen.

criteria.look_for: Does the picker show the number of nights while choosing?

observations.Booking.com: Date field shows the range only (e.g. 'Sat, Mar 7 – Sun, Mar 8'); night count not shown in the field.
observations.Agoda: Tooltip on the range shows '(1 night)' and the confirm button reads 'OK (1 night)'.
observations.Trip.com: Field shows the dates plus '1 night' on the right.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Price calendar shows a nightly price under every date; footer shows '(2 Nights) 41 USD / Night, taxes and fees included'.

criteria.implication: Show night count in the CTA; consider nightly prices in the calendar for flexible travellers.

criteria.look_for: Rooms, adults, children in one clear control; child ages handled.

observations.Booking.com: One line: '1 room · 2 adults · No children'.
observations.Agoda: One line: '1 room 2 adults 0 children'.
observations.Trip.com: Full-screen stepper for rooms/adults/children with guidance on child ages and when to add rooms.

criteria.implication: Explain child-age and room-split rules inside the picker, not after search.

criteria.look_for: Can users narrow before searching (rating, breakfast, offers)?

observations.Booking.com: None on the form.
observations.Agoda: 'Show limited time offers first' checkbox.
observations.Trip.com: Quick chips on the form: Filters, Guest rating 4.5+, Breakfast included; 'Show homes & apartments first'.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Points vs standard rate and room count chips above the calendar.

criteria.implication: Offer 2–3 high-intent quick filters on the search form.

criteria.look_for: Do promos compete with the main task?

observations.Booking.com: Large credit-card promo directly below search.
observations.Agoda: Sponsored properties and coupon cards below search.
observations.Trip.com: New-user promo pack and deals carousel below search.

criteria.implication: Keep the area below search quiet until the user has searched.

criteria.criterion: All-in price on the results card
criteria.look_for: Is the price on the card the real total (taxes and fees in), and is that stated?
criteria.driver: Unexpected extra costs / total not upfront

observations.Booking.com: Shows stay total ('2 nights: $250 $133') plus per-night line; tax inclusion not stated on the card.
observations.Agoda: Price labelled 'after taxes + fees'; a bottom sheet explains 'What you see is what you pay'.
observations.Trip.com: Large per-night price plus 'Total (incl. taxes & fees)' under every card.
observations.Airbnb: 'Display total price' toggle is OFF by default; card shows '$49 night · $56 total' (before taxes).
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Room cards show 'USD / Night — Taxes and fees included'.

criteria.implication: Default to an all-in price and say so in plain words on the card.

criteria.look_for: Easy to reach, active filters visible, result count updates.

observations.Booking.com: Sort / Filter / Map bar plus property-type chips with counts (Hotels 1044).
observations.Agoda: Filters / Price / Sort chips; sort includes lowest price, stars, top guest ratings.
observations.Trip.com: Active filters shown as removable chips; button shows live count 'Show Results (400+)'.
observations.Airbnb: Filter icon next to search pill.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Chips for room type, points, standard and special rates.

criteria.implication: Show applied filters as chips and a live result count on the apply button.

criteria.look_for: Can users switch to a map from results?

observations.Booking.com: Map button in the top bar.
observations.Agoda: Floating List / Gallery / Map switch.
observations.Trip.com: Floating Map / Saved pill.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Map on the property page (single-brand flow).

criteria.implication: Keep a floating map toggle visible while scrolling.

criteria.look_for: Rating, location, cancellation visible without clutter.

observations.Booking.com: Score, review count, distance to centre, room type and beds.
observations.Agoda: Score and location, but many badges stacked (Sponsored, Boosted, coupon applied x2, Rare price, rankings).
observations.Trip.com: Rating, nearby landmark, free-cancellation tag, deal tags.

criteria.implication: Limit badges to two per card; always show cancellation status.

criteria.look_for: Are scarcity cues honest and restrained?

observations.Booking.com: Strikethrough discounts.
observations.Agoda: Heavy: 'Only 1 left', 'Booked 19 times in 24h', sold-out cards with average booked price.
observations.Trip.com: 'Our last 3!', '$2 cheaper than when you last viewed', 'Saved by 235 people'.

criteria.implication: Prefer helpful signals (price dropped since last view) over pressure.

criteria.look_for: Are paid placements clearly marked?

observations.Booking.com: Banner explains how payments affect listing order; card promo inline.
observations.Agoda: 'Sponsored' and 'Boosted' labels; PayLater promo card inline in results.
observations.Trip.com: Deal tags; no sponsored label seen.

criteria.implication: If ranking is paid, say so near the list.

criteria.look_for: Enough photos, easy to browse, count shown.

observations.Booking.com: Grid of 5 with '+71' tile.
observations.Agoda: Full-width carousel with '1/36'.

criteria.implication: Show a grid preview so users see variety before tapping.

criteria.look_for: Score, count, category breakdown, relevant snippets.

observations.Booking.com: Category bars (Cleanliness, Location, Value…), traveller-type quotes, AI 'Ask about the guest reviews'.
observations.Agoda: Score plus '84% of guests liked location' and short quotes.

criteria.implication: Break reviews into categories; surface the one most relevant to the user.

criteria.look_for: Are the decision-making facts summarised near the top?

observations.Booking.com: 'Property highlights' tiles and 'Most popular facilities'.
observations.Agoda: 'Top reasons for booking': free cancellation, ideal location.
observations.Airbnb: Host card with Superhost and years hosting.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Address, phone, map near the top.

criteria.implication: Summarise 2–3 reasons (cancellation, location score) above the fold.

criteria.criterion: Sticky CTA with price and reassurance
criteria.look_for: Does the fixed bottom bar show price and risk reducers?

observations.Booking.com: 'You won't be charged yet' above Select; no price in the bar.
observations.Agoda: 'Start at S$30' plus 'Choose my room'.
observations.Airbnb: '$356 for 2 nights' plus 'Free cancellation' tag and Reserve.

criteria.implication: Sticky bar = total for the stay + cancellation status + CTA.

criteria.look_for: Map, address, nearby context.

observations.Booking.com: Distance to downtown on results; full location further down.
observations.Agoda: 'What's nearby?' link and location score.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Embedded map, address, phone, directions icon.

criteria.implication: Show a small map and travel time to key points.

criteria.look_for: For each rate: meal plan, cancellation, payment timing, guests covered.

observations.Agoda: Room card lists breakfast included, last check-in, free cancellation date, 'No payment until 7 July'.
observations.Trip.com: Rate box: free cancellation before 12:00 Mar 16, instant confirmation, prepay online, price for 2 adults, total incl. taxes.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Room list then 'View Rates'; chips for standard, special and points rates.
observations.World of Hyatt: 'Members Advance Purchase' with a 'Rate Rules' link; prices as avg/night.

criteria.implication: One compact box per rate with all four facts; no extra tap needed.

criteria.look_for: Is the same price basis used from list to checkout?

observations.Booking.com: Total stay on results, '$44 includes taxes and fees' at checkout — consistent.
observations.Agoda: 'After taxes + fees' throughout — consistent.
observations.Trip.com: Per-night plus total on cards, but budget filter is per night excl. taxes — inconsistent.
observations.Airbnb: Per night on results, total with service fee only at checkout — inconsistent.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Per night incl. taxes, then itemised 'Est. Taxes & Fees' at review.

criteria.implication: Pick one basis (all-in total) and keep it from search to payment.

criteria.look_for: Price alerts, calendar pricing, pay-later rates.

observations.Booking.com: Not captured.
observations.Agoda: 'Day Use' tab; pay-later rates.
observations.Trip.com: 'Notify me when the price drops' toggle on room page.

criteria.implication: Add price-drop alerts for undecided users.

criteria.look_for: Is scarcity at rate level honest?

observations.Agoda: 'We have limited availability at this price - book now!' on the room card.
observations.Trip.com: 'New Guest Offer' and discount tags on rate.

criteria.implication: Use factual tags; avoid 'book now' pressure copy.

criteria.look_for: How many screens to payment; is progress clear?

observations.Booking.com: Several screens with a generic 'Next step' button.
observations.Agoda: CTA reads 'NEXT: FINAL STEP' with 'You will pay SGD0 today' under it.
observations.Trip.com: Single long form ending with Book.
observations.Airbnb: Single 'Request to book' summary with editable rows, then extra steps for photo and ID.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Single 'Review Reservation' screen (logged-in member, details prefilled).
observations.World of Hyatt: Long 'Your Information' form including full postal address.

criteria.implication: Name the step in the CTA and keep checkout to one review screen where possible.

criteria.criterion: Forced account or extra identity steps
criteria.look_for: Does the user have to create an account, add a photo or verify ID?

observations.Booking.com: Captured logged in; guest checkout not visible.
observations.Agoda: Captured logged in; guest checkout not visible.
observations.Trip.com: Captured logged in; guest checkout not visible.
observations.Airbnb: Requires profile photo and identity verification before booking completes.

criteria.implication: Self-test guest checkout on each app; avoid ID or address steps unless the property needs them.

criteria.look_for: Cancellation and prepayment terms stated in plain words.

observations.Booking.com: 'Booking conditions': free cancellation before Mar 18; no prepayment needed — pay at the property.
observations.Agoda: 'Stay flexible! Cancel for free before 9 July 2026'.
observations.Trip.com: Fine print list plus a sticky 'Rest easy with free cancellation' bar.
observations.Airbnb: Free cancellation date with link to full policy; ground rules.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Not shown on the review screen in capture.
observations.World of Hyatt: Deposit and non-refundable policy in dense text with a consent line.

criteria.implication: Two green ticked lines: cancellation deadline and when you pay.

criteria.look_for: Are all fees visible before the final step, with no surprises?

observations.Booking.com: Sticky '$44 — Includes taxes and fees'.
observations.Agoda: Full breakdown: original price, coupons applied, tax 9% and service charge 10% included.
observations.Trip.com: 'Pay at hotel' total with local-currency equivalent.
observations.Airbnb: Service fee and taxes appear only in checkout price details.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Summary of charges with 'Est. Taxes & Fees' and approximate home-currency total.

criteria.implication: Show the breakdown, but make sure the total matches what the results page promised.

criteria.look_for: Optional, clearly not guaranteed.

observations.Booking.com: Not captured.
observations.Agoda: Can be added post-booking via self-service.
observations.Trip.com: Optional section (e.g. elevator proximity) with 'cannot guarantee' note.
observations.World of Hyatt: Separate sheet for smoking preference and comments.

criteria.implication: Keep requests optional and collapsed; state they are not guaranteed.

criteria.look_for: Upsells or loyalty content that pull attention from paying.

observations.Booking.com: Genius loyalty card inside the booking overview.
observations.Agoda: 'Savings corner' coupons (auto-applied, helpful).
observations.Trip.com: 'Earn Trip Coins' row.

criteria.implication: Keep loyalty to one line; auto-apply savings instead of asking users to hunt.

criteria.look_for: Is payment timing a clear choice with the amount due today?

observations.Booking.com: 'When do you want to pay?' — Pay at the property or Pay now, with 'your card won't be charged' explanation.
observations.Agoda: 'You will pay SGD0 today' and the charge date.
observations.Trip.com: 'Pay at Hotel' option.

criteria.implication: Make 'when you pay' an explicit choice and always show 'due today'.

criteria.look_for: E-wallets, virtual account, minimarket, PayLater.

observations.Booking.com: Card, Apple Pay, Klarna, Afterpay (US capture); no SEA methods visible.
observations.Agoda: Card form only in capture (Singapore); Atome PayLater promoted in results.
observations.Trip.com: Card form only in capture.

criteria.implication: Mobbin captures are mostly US/SG. Self-test Traveloka and Tiket.com for e-wallet, VA and minimarket patterns.

criteria.look_for: Visible trust signals at card entry.

observations.Booking.com: Card brand logos; CVC helper.
observations.Agoda: Lock icons in card fields; terms line.
observations.Trip.com: '100% security guaranteed' badge and 'Your payment information is protected' under the button.
observations.Airbnb: Lock icon in card number field; card logos.

criteria.implication: Place a short reassurance line directly under the pay button.

criteria.look_for: Clear success state, booking number, what happens next.

observations.Booking.com: Confirmation followed by Genius promo and a survey.
observations.Agoda: Confirmed message covered by a WhatsApp marketing pop-up.
observations.Trip.com: 'Processing' status with booking number, message or call property, add to wallet and calendar.
observations.Airbnb: 'Your stay is pending' — host has 24 hours to accept.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: 'You're All Set', confirmation number, email sent, stay summary.
observations.World of Hyatt: Confirmation number plus Apple Wallet room key.

criteria.implication: Lead with status + booking number + what happens next; no pop-ups.

criteria.look_for: Can users change, cancel, get receipts without support?

observations.Booking.com: Not captured.
observations.Agoda: Self-service list: change dates, cancel, resend voucher, receipt, special requests.
observations.Trip.com: Cancel booking and Options buttons on the booking page.
observations.Marriott Bonvoy: Trips tab with Current / Past / Canceled.

criteria.implication: Put the top 4–6 self-service actions on the confirmation page.

patterns.pattern: All-in price labelled 'after taxes + fees', with a one-tap 'What you see is what you pay' explanation
patterns.why: Directly addresses the #1 abandonment driver: unexpected extra costs.

patterns.pattern: Per-night price large, 'Total (incl. taxes & fees)' small underneath on every card
patterns.why: Serves both mental models (nightly budget and trip total) without a toggle.

patterns.pattern: Applied filters as removable chips plus live count on the apply button ('Show Results (400+)')
patterns.why: Users see the effect of each filter before committing.

patterns.pattern: Price calendar with nightly price under each date and total nights in the footer
patterns.why: Lets flexible travellers find the cheapest dates without repeated searches.

patterns.pattern: Sticky bar with stay total, 'Free cancellation' tag and Reserve
patterns.why: Price and risk reducer are always visible at the moment of decision.

patterns.pattern: Review category bars plus 'Ask about the guest reviews' prompts
patterns.why: Helps users answer their specific worry (cleanliness, location) quickly.

patterns.pattern: One box per rate: cancellation deadline, instant confirmation, payment timing, guests covered, total
patterns.why: All four decision facts visible without opening 'rate rules'.

patterns.pattern: 'Booking conditions' block with two green ticks: free cancellation deadline and 'no prepayment needed'
patterns.why: Removes the two biggest doubts right before payment.

patterns.pattern: CTA names the step ('NEXT: FINAL STEP') and shows 'You will pay SGD0 today' under it
patterns.why: Sets expectations on effort left and money taken now.

patterns.pattern: 'When do you want to pay?' choice between pay at property and pay now
patterns.why: Turns payment anxiety into a choice the user controls.

patterns.pattern: Clean success screen: status, confirmation number, email sent, stay summary
patterns.why: No distractions at the moment the user needs reassurance.

patterns.pattern: Self-service list on the booking: change dates, cancel, resend voucher, receipt
patterns.why: Cuts support contacts and builds trust in booking again.

patterns.pattern: 'Display total price' toggle off by default; fees and taxes appear only at checkout
patterns.why: The exact late-fee surprise the abandonment research warns about.

patterns.pattern: Stacking 5+ badges per card (sponsored, coupons, rankings, scarcity)
patterns.why: Key facts get lost; feels pushy.

patterns.pattern: Budget filter on a different price basis (per night excl. taxes) from the cards (incl. taxes)
patterns.why: Users set a budget and then see prices that look over it.

patterns.pattern: Profile photo and identity verification added at the end of booking
patterns.why: Late, unexpected effort right before commitment.

patterns.pattern: Full postal address required for a hotel stay
patterns.why: Adds fields that most hotels do not need.

patterns.pattern: Marketing pop-up (WhatsApp sign-up) covering the booking confirmation
patterns.why: Interrupts the reassurance moment; looks like an error state.

patterns.pattern: Wallet sheet listing e-wallet balance with Top up, saved cards, and 'Virtual Account' as an add method
patterns.why: Indonesian payment pattern to adapt while Traveloka / Tiket.com are self-tested.

friction.what: Results show '$49 night · $56 total' with the total-price toggle off; at checkout a service fee and taxes push the total to $64.84.
friction.implication: Show the all-in total from the first results screen.

friction.what: After entering payment, the user must add a profile photo and verify identity before the booking completes.
friction.implication: Never add new effort after payment details; ask only what the property needs, and ask early.

friction.what: Booking ends as 'pending' — host has 24 hours to accept.
friction.implication: Prefer instant confirmation; if pending, state the max wait and what happens to the money.

friction.what: WhatsApp sign-up pop-up covers the 'booking confirmed' message.
friction.implication: Keep confirmation free of marketing; ask for opt-ins later.

friction.what: Cards carry many stacked badges (sponsored, boosted, two coupon lines, ranking, scarcity), pushing key facts down.
friction.implication: Cap badges per card and prioritise cancellation and rating.

friction.what: 'We have limited availability at this price - book now!' pressure copy on the room card.
friction.implication: Use factual availability ('2 rooms left at this price') without commands.

friction.what: Budget filter works on per-night price excluding taxes, while cards highlight totals including taxes.
friction.implication: Use the same price basis in filters and on cards.

friction.what: Large credit-card promo sits directly under the search form.
friction.implication: Keep the area under search free of cross-sell.

friction.what: Sticky bar says 'You won't be charged yet' but shows no price.
friction.implication: Pair reassurance copy with the stay total.

friction.what: Guest form requires full home address; deposit and non-refundable policy shown as dense text.
friction.implication: Ask for name, email, phone only; summarise policy in two plain lines.

friction.what: Rates shown as 'Avg/Night' only; total not visible on the rate list.
friction.implication: Show the stay total next to each rate.

friction.what: Rooms say 'taxes and fees included', but the review screen itemises 'Est. Taxes & Fees' — the word 'estimated' can raise doubt.
friction.implication: Avoid 'estimated' at final review; show the exact amount charged.
